provenance.asset_description: Two separate images overlayed over a blurred background. The left image is  Goldpebble, a large snake with dark scales that resemble river rocks and studded with gold nuggets. It’s flicking its tongue out curiously, smelling its surroundings. The left image is Wylderheart, an elven woman wearing elegant elven armor and wielding a sword. Standing beside her is a tall and thin dog with tall ears and pale white fur. The Pathfinder second edition logo is in the bottom left corner
